C1823.title: Yongjia, Wenzhou: Express Delivery Managers Changed Full-Truckload Product Types to Embezzle Over 2 Million Yuan
C1823.summary: Wang, Tang, Hu and seven others were managers of an express delivery department at a Wenzhou transport company. The company's full-truckload business was split into standard LTL, heavy freight parcels, and line-haul freight, with line-haul priced slightly higher. Wang et al. altered the product type of shipments to lower the transport price shown in the internal system, causing the system's 'receivable' to fall below actual receipts, then fabricated customer full-truckload orders to balance the books and embezzle the difference. From 2020 to 2022 they misappropriated over 2 million yuan. In September 2024, the Yongjia County Court in Wenzhou sentenced the 10 defendants to prison terms ranging from six months to two years and three months for embezzlement.
